items.desc: Rapid touch & barcode billing terminal, instant product search, discounts, multi-tender payments (Cash, Card, UPI, Customer Khata), instant receipt generation, and real-time inventory deduction.

items.module: Dynamic Inventory & Multi-Batch Tracking (FIFO / LIFO / WAC)
items.desc: Inward batch/lot tracking with landed cost (freight, tax). Supports FIFO, LIFO, and Weighted Average Costing (WAC) with low-stock alerts and out-of-stock prevention.

items.module: Barcode & QR Label Printing Engine & Ledger
items.desc: Built-in barcode & QR code generator for items and batches. Supports thermal label formats (stickers, tags) and searchable Barcode Audit Ledger for tracking item movement.
Procurement engine with Goods Received Notes (GRN), vendor records, inward purchase bills, supplier khata ledger, and purchase history tracking.

items.module: Customer CRM, Khata Credit Ledger & Dues Management
items.desc: Customer directory with purchase logs, credit limits, khata ledger, partial payment tracking, settlement receipts, and auto-computed outstanding balances printed on receipts.

items.module: Thermal Bluetooth, USB & Desktop ESC/POS Printing
items.desc: Direct printing to 58mm & 80mm ESC/POS Bluetooth printers, desktop receipt printers, and full A4/A5 tax invoices with GST tax breakdown and HSN summaries.

items.module: Daily Cash Drawer, Shift Reconciliation & Expense Tracker
items.desc: Shift management with opening cash float, real-time sales tally, daily expense categorization (supplies, tea, transport), and day-end drawer reconciliation.

items.module: Sales Returns, Damage Stock & Broken Inventory Write-Offs
items.desc: Fast returns against invoice or direct exchange, automated restocking or damage quarantine, credit note generation, and dedicated broken stock ledger.
Granular multi-tier roles: Super Admin, Store Admin, Cashier, and Sales Staff. Protects sensitive purchase costs, margins, and financial reports from floor staff.

items.module: Business Intelligence, Sales Analytics & GST Reports
items.desc: Interactive dashboard with daily/monthly sales volume, profit & loss analysis, fast vs dead stock analytics, customer dues, and 1-click GST tax filing export.

items.module: Cross-Platform Native Android App & Responsive Web PWA
items.desc: Production Android APK build powered by Ionic Capacitor for handheld POS devices with offline IndexedDB resilience, plus responsive desktop Chrome / iPad web portal.

items.module: Firebase Cloud Backend, Multi-Device Sync & SSL Hosting
items.desc: Google Cloud Firestore real-time database, Firebase Auth, automated cloud backups, sub-second multi-device sync, and high-speed SSL hosting — first year 100% FREE.

financialSection.totalBannerText: TOTAL PROJECT VALUE: Rs.18,000 INR | SPECIAL OFFER: -Rs.3,000 | NET PAYABLE: Rs.15,000 INR

bullets.text: Rs.1,299/year (approx. Rs.108/month) — Highly discounted maintenance package structured exclusively for Shiek Enterprises.
Covers Firestore reads/writes, real-time stock sync across multiple terminals, cloud data storage, and automated SSL certificate renewals.
Covers Android updates, Ionic/Angular framework security patches, thermal printer driver updates, and minor UI adjustments.

Commercial POS/ERP platforms typically charge Rs.12,000–Rs.24,000/year in annual software licensing and cloud subscriptions. Flow's nominal Rs.1,299/year rate represents a long-term partnership commitment.
Annual fee of Rs.1,299 will apply only from the 13th month onwards (first 12 months are 100% free).
Standard platform fee of Rs.18,000 INR discounted by Rs.3,000 INR as an inaugural partnership offer, establishing a net payable investment of Rs.15,000 INR.
50% mobilization advance (Rs.7,500) upon agreement sign-off; remaining 50% (Rs.7,500) payable upon final production deployment, printer verification & staff handover.
Firebase cloud infrastructure, real-time database, and SSL certificate are 100% complimentary for the first 12 months from delivery date, compliments of Flow.
Annual cloud maintenance renewal of Rs.1,299/year will apply starting from month 13 onwards.
All software bugs, calculation discrepancies, and system issues reported within 12 months of handover will be rectified promptly with zero additional charges.
Any future custom modules outside the agreed 12 modules (such as e-commerce customer web store or third-party accounting integrations) will be scoped and quoted separately.
Direct phone and WhatsApp support via +91 8903424281 during business hours (Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST).
Complete operational walkthrough covering POS billing shortcuts, barcode printing, batch purchase entry, khata ledger management, and day-end shift closing.
100% of product data, pricing, supplier records, customer lists, and financial transactions belong exclusively to Shiek Enterprises. Flow does not store or share customer data.
Pre-tested compatibility with standard 58mm/80mm Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal printers, USB laser barcode scanners, and Android tablets/smartphones.
